itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Arrival & Duomo District
• Arrive at MXP or LIN; Malpensa Express or bus to Centrale (validated 45–55 min)
• Check-in near Duomo or Brera; lunch at autogrill or Navigli cafe
• Afternoon: Duomo di Milano (pre-book roof or terraces); Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II
• Evening: aperitivo in Navigli; dinner along the canals
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Art, Design & La Scala Corridor
• Morning: Santa Maria delle Grazie (Last Supper; pre-book timed entry)
• Lunch: risotto or cotoletta near Brera
• Afternoon: Pinacoteca di Brera or Castello Sforzesco; Parco Sempione
• Evening: opera at La Scala district or dinner in Porta Nuova
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — Lakes or Fashion District Finish
• Morning: half-day to Lake Como (train to Como or Varenna) or Quadrilatero fashion walk
• Lunch: lakeside trattoria or Eataly Smeraldo
• Afternoon: return for Last-minute Duomo photos or San Siro stadium tour if pre-booked
• Evening: farewell dinner in Brera; pack with Malpensa Express timing confirmed

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred helps sequence Milan's timed entries (Last Supper, Duomo roof) with Malpensa transfers so ground-transport days stay executable.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 —
• Arrive at Munich Airport (MUC) and take the S8 train to Marienplatz (45 min)
• Explore Marienplatz and visit the New Town Hall (1.5 hours)
• Lunch at Viktualienmarkt (1 hour)
• Visit the Munich Residenz (2 hours)
• Dinner at Hofbräuhaus Munich (1.5 hours)
• Return to hotel via metro (30 min)
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 —
• Breakfast at hotel (1 hour)
• Take the U2 metro to Nymphenburg Palace (30 min)
• Explore Nymphenburg Palace and Gardens (2.5 hours)
• Lunch at a nearby café (1 hour)
• Visit the BMW Museum (2 hours)
• Dinner in the Schwabing district (1.5 hours)
• Return to hotel via tram (30 min)
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 —
• Breakfast at hotel (1 hour)
• Take the S-Bahn to Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial Site (40 min)
• Tour the memorial site (2 hours)
• Lunch in Dachau (1 hour)
• Return to Munich and visit the English Garden (2 hours)
• Dinner at a traditional Bavarian restaurant (1.5 hours)
• Depart from Munich Airport (MUC) (45 min)

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred helps you navigate Munich's rich history and vibrant culture effortlessly.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Fira Caldera & Arrival
• Arrive at JTR; pre-book transfer or bus to Fira (validated 25–40 min)
• Check-in caldera-view hotel in Fira or Imerovigli; light lunch with cliff views
• Afternoon: Fira cliff walk, Museum of Prehistoric Thera if open
• Evening: sunset drinks in Imerovigli; dinner with caldera timing confirmed
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Oia & Beaches
• Morning: bus or taxi to Oia before crowds; Amoudi Bay steps
• Lunch: seafood in Oia or Fira return
• Afternoon: Red Beach or Perissa black-sand block (choose one; 2+ hrs)
• Evening: Oia sunset spot (arrive 90 min early in peak season); late dinner in Fira
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — Akrotiri & Wine Route
• Morning: Akrotiri archaeological site (pre-book timed entry)
• Lunch: Pyrgos village taverna or winery tasting
• Afternoon: Santo Wines or Art Space winery; pack for ferry/flight buffer
• Evening: farewell meze; confirm JTR transfer with island traffic buffer

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred sequences Santorini ferry/flight buffers, Oia sunset crowds, and caldera hotel transfers so island days stay executable.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Beach & Bauhaus Core
• Arrive at TLV; train or taxi to central Tel Aviv (validated 25–40 min)
• Check-in near Rothschild or the beach strip; lunch at Carmel Market
• Afternoon: Rothschild Boulevard Bauhaus walk, Independence Hall if timed
• Evening: beach promenade sunset; dinner in Levinsky spice market area
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Jaffa & Neve Tzedek
• Morning: Old Jaffa port, flea market, St. Peter's Church views
• Lunch: hummus in Jaffa or Florentin
• Afternoon: Neve Tzedek galleries; optional ANU Museum
• Evening: dinner in Sarona or Port area; note Friday sunset Shabbat timing if relevant
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — North Coast or Culture Finish
• Morning: Tel Aviv Museum of Art OR Herzliya marina half-day
• Lunch: shakshuka brunch or fish at the port
• Afternoon: Sarona Market errands or final beach block
• Evening: farewell dinner; confirm TLV departure with Friday/Saturday transport checks

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred helps pace Tel Aviv beach days, Jaffa walks, and Shabbat-aware timing so city breaks stay realistic.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Giza Plateau
• Arrive at CAI; pre-book driver or Uber to Giza area (validated 45–75 min with traffic)
• Check-in near Giza or Zamalek; lunch with pyramid views if possible
• Afternoon: Giza pyramids and Great Sphinx (pre-book guide/tickets)
• Evening: light Sound & Light show OR early night before heavy walking day
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Egyptian Museum & Khan el-Khalili
• Morning: Grand Egyptian Museum or Egyptian Museum (check which wing is open)
• Lunch: falafel near Tahrir or Zamalek café
• Afternoon: Khan el-Khalili bazaar with fixed meet point for groups
• Evening: Nile felucca at sunset; dinner in Zamalek
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — Islamic Cairo & Citadel
• Morning: Saladin Citadel and Mosque of Muhammad Ali
• Lunch: koshari or grilled chicken in Islamic Cairo
• Afternoon: Al-Azhar Park views or Coptic Cairo if time
• Evening: farewell meal; confirm CAI transfer with peak-hour buffer

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred builds Cairo days around traffic buffers, museum hours, and Giza timing so pyramid visits do not collapse the rest of the trip.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Arrival & Central Taipei Reset
• Arrive at TPE; Airport MRT to Taipei Main Station or a taxi to Da'an/Ximending base (validated 35–55 min)
• Check-in near Ximending, Da'an, or Zhongzheng for easier MRT coverage; lunch with beef noodle soup or xiao long bao
• Afternoon: Chiang Kai-shek Memorial Hall, Liberty Square, and Yongkang Street without cross-city backtracking
• Evening: light first-night finish at Ningxia or Raohe Night Market; keep the post-flight block flexible for families
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Skyline, Museums & Neighborhood Logic
• Morning: Taipei 101 area, Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hall, and Xinyi walking loop before afternoon heat or rain builds
• Lunch: Din Tai Fung, food court, or local set meal in Xinyi
• Afternoon: National Palace Museum OR Huashan 1914 / Songshan Cultural Park depending whether the trip skews family, design, or classic sightseeing
• Evening: dinner in Da'an or Xinyi; optional Elephant Mountain only if energy and weather still cooperate
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — Family-Friendly Extension or Scenic Buffer
• Morning: Taipei Zoo plus Maokong Gondola for a lower-friction family block, or Beitou hot-spring district for a slower adult-heavy pace
• Lunch: tea-house meal in Maokong or casual lunch in Beitou/Tamsui corridor
• Afternoon: return via MRT with buffer for shopping in Ximending, Taipei Main, or a Tamsui riverfront finish if the weather is clear
• Evening: farewell dinner, repack, and confirm airport timing with enough buffer for TPE departure

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred helps pace Taipei around Airport MRT transfers, night-market timing, rain-friendly backups, and family-friendly MRT sequencing.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Arrival, Central City Reset & Riverside Logic
• Arrive at CHC; taxi, shuttle, or rideshare to the central city/Riccarton base (validated 20–30 min)
• Check-in near the central city, Riverside, or Riccarton so jet-lag recovery stays walkable; easy lunch at Riverside Market
• Afternoon: Avon River / Botanic Gardens / Tram corridor loop instead of stacking long transfers on arrival day
• Evening: early dinner in the central city; keep the first night light if the trip includes children or a same-day Australian arrival
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Family-Friendly Christchurch Without Cross-City Friction
• Morning: Margaret Mahy Playground, Tūranga, and nearby central-city blocks while energy is highest
• Lunch: casual central-city stop before moving east or south
• Afternoon: choose one clean second block — Christchurch Gondola + Sumner finish OR Willowbank / Orana style wildlife stop, depending weather and family pace
• Evening: dinner back near the hotel so the day does not end with a heavy return leg across town
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — Scenic Extension or Easy Buffer Day
• Morning: half-day to Akaroa OR a slower local day with markets, museums, and riverfront time depending driving tolerance
• Lunch: Akaroa harbour meal or a central-city café if keeping the day local
• Afternoon: souvenir, snack, and repack buffer before departure rather than over-programming the final block
• Evening: confirm CHC airport timing with enough margin for rental-car return or family packing delays

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred helps pace Christchurch around short airport transfers, family-friendly city blocks, and optional South Island day extensions without wasting the trip on backtracking.

itinerary.day1:
Day 1 — Arrival, Aerocity or Connaught Place Reset
• Arrive at DEL; Metro Airport Express or pre-booked car into Aerocity/Connaught Place (validated 20–40 min depending hotel)
• Check-in and keep the first block light after flight arrival; lunch in Aerocity or Connaught Place
• Afternoon: India Gate, Kartavya Path and National War Memorial loop if heat allows
• Evening: early dinner in Khan Market or Connaught Place; sleep early before heavier monument day
itinerary.day2:
Day 2 — Old Delhi and Mughal Core
• Morning: Jama Masjid and Chandni Chowk with early start before traffic and crowd density rises
• Lunch: Old Delhi food stop with a fixed regroup point for groups
• Afternoon: Red Fort exterior zone or Raj Ghat, then transfer with buffer toward New Delhi
• Evening: recover in Lodhi Colony or South Delhi; avoid stacking too many cross-city hops after 5pm traffic
itinerary.day3:
Day 3 — Humayun's Tomb, Qutub and Departure Logic
• Morning: Humayun's Tomb when gates open, then Lodhi Garden or Nizamuddin area depending pace
• Lunch: South Delhi café block near Hauz Khas or Mehrauli corridor
• Afternoon: Qutub Minar with realistic buffer for security and queue time
• Evening: farewell dinner and pack; confirm DEL transfer with heavy traffic margin, especially for international departures

meta.faqSnippet: Alfred helps pace Delhi around airport transfers, monument queues, and cross-city traffic so first-time itineraries stay executable.
